nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances; written by _approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Private uint256 total supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Generator version string set once in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Atomically increases spender allowance by addedValue and calls _approve.
Atomically decreases spender allowance by subtractedValue with a require check.
Internal transfer core; reads/writes _balances and invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal mint core; increases _totalSupply and credits _balances.
Internal burn core; debits _balances and decreases _totalSupply.
Internal approval core; writes the _allowances mapping for owner/spender.
Virtual hook invoked before any transfer, mint or burn; empty by default.
Context helper returning msg.sender for meta-transaction aware callers.
Payable ServicePayer constructor that forwards msg.value to an external IPayable receiver.
Payable deploy constructor; requires non-zero initial balance and mints the whole supply to _msgSender().
Constructor that stores the generator version string into _version.
Caller-controlled address used as owner/minter/allowance owner throughout the token.
Arbitrary external payable call to IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed during construction.
Token name passed to the SimpleERC20 constructor and ERC20 base constructor.
Token symbol passed to the SimpleERC20 constructor and ERC20 base constructor.
Initial supply amount, required to be greater than zero, minted to the deployer.
Payable address forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor as the fee receiver.
Service name string forwarded to the external IPayable.pay call.
Payable address on which IPayable(receiver).pay is called with msg.value.
Destination address of a transfer / transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved or approved.
Source address in transferFrom and in the internal _transfer.
Address granted or reduced an allowance.
Allowance owner queried in allowance() and modified in _approve.
Version string stored by the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Allowance increment added in increaseAllowance.
Allowance decrement subtracted in decreaseAllowance.
Locally cached allowance read in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance and passed back to _approve.
Locally cached sender balance in _transfer used for the balance require and subtraction.
Locally cached account balance in _burn used for the balance require and subtraction.
Beneficiary address of _mint.
Source address supplied to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Destination address supplied to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.

edges.reason: transfer() calls _msgSender() to resolve the msg.sender caller.
transfer() delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _transfer() to move tokens after allowance checks.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to write the reduced allowance.
approve() delegates to the internal _approve() core.
increaseAllowance() calls _approve() with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance() calls _approve() with the reduced allowance.
_transfer() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning.
_transfer() reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_mint() credits the minted amount into _balances.
_burn() debits the burned amount from _balances.
_mint() increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn() decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_approve() writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
increaseAllowance() performs allowance + addedValue addition before storing it in _allowances.
decreaseAllowance() performs currentAllowance - subtractedValue subtraction guarded only by a require.
transferFrom() computes currentAllowance - amount and writes the result back to _allowances.
msg.sender becomes the owner of the transfer through _msgSender().
msg.sender is the key of _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] used to authorise transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
_msgSender() returns the raw msg.sender value.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint() to create the initial supply.
The constructor mints the entire initial supply to _msgSender(), i.e. to the untrusted caller.
ServicePayer constructor makes an arbitrary external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value} which can re-enter before the supply is minted.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the inherited ServicePayer constructor with feeReceiver_ and the service name.
feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded from the SimpleERC20 constructor into ServicePayer.
serviceName string is passed into the ServicePayer constructor and forwarded to pay().
receiver address is cast to IPayable and becomes the target of the external pay() call.
name_ is stored in _name via the ERC20 base constructor.
symbol_ is stored in _symbol via the ERC20 base constructor.
initialBalance_ is validated with require(>0) and minted to the caller.
version_ is assigned to the _version state variable.
GeneratorCopyright constructor writes the version string into _version.
recipient parameter flows into transfer() as the receiving address.
amount parameter flows into transfer() as the moved value.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom() as the receiving address.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom() for both allowance and balance checks.
sender parameter is the allowance owner key and balance source in transferFrom().
recipient reaches the core _transfer() balance update.
amount reaches the core _transfer() balance update and require check.
sender reaches the core _transfer() balance debit.
spender parameter is the allowance target in approve().
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry incremented in increaseAllowance().
addedValue is used in the unchecked-style allowance addition inside increaseAllowance().
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry decremented in decreaseAllowance().
subtractedValue is used in the allowance subtraction inside decreaseAllowance().
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in the allowance() view.
transferFrom() stores _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the currentAllowance local.
currentAllowance - amount is passed into _approve(), the allowance decrement.
_transfer() copies _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local.
_burn() copies _balances[account] into the accountBalance local.
account parameter is the mint beneficiary in _mint().
from parameter is forwarded to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to parameter is forwarded to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.

normalization_plan.reason: Deployment-time token name parameter only used to initialise the ERC20 state.
Deployment-time token symbol parameter only used to initialise the ERC20 state.
Initial supply parameter consumed by the constructor require and mint call.
Fee receiver parameter forwarded straight into the ServicePayer base constructor.
Service label string only forwarded to the external pay() invocation.
Payable receiver address is the target of the external IPayable.pay call.
Transfer destination collapses into the core balance-mutating function.
Transferred amount is consumed by the core _transfer balance arithmetic.
Source address is consumed by the core _transfer balance arithmetic.
Spender address is the key written by the core _approve function.
Owner address is the key written by the core _approve function.
Version string is only stored into the _version state variable.
Increment operand of the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
Decrement operand of the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
Cached allowance local is the value written back by the core _approve function.
Cached balance local is consumed by the core _transfer balance arithmetic.
Cached balance local is consumed by the core _burn balance arithmetic.
Beneficiary address consumed by the core _mint function.
Hook argument only forwarded to the core transfer hook.
Hook argument only forwarded to the core transfer hook.
